title: [crossguid] Build error on Linux with gcc v13

labels.name: category:port-bug
labels.description: The issue is with a library, which is something the port should already support

body:
It seems that `<cstdint>` was implicitly included in previous versions of gcc but now compilation of crossguid fails like so:

```
[1/3] /usr/lib/ccache/bin/c++ -DGUID_LIBUUID -I/home/alex/code/vcpkg/buildtrees/crossguid/src/08ee1b7681-f70a1f9530.clean/include -I/home/alex/code/vcpkg/installed/x64-linux/include -fPIC -g -std=c++17 -fPIC -MD -MT CMakeFiles/crossguid.dir/src/guid.cpp.o -MF CMakeFiles/crossguid.dir/src/guid.cpp.o.d -o CMakeFiles/crossguid.dir/src/guid.cpp.o -c /home/alex/code/vcpkg/buildtrees/crossguid/src/08ee1b7681-f70a1f9530.clean/src/guid.cpp
FAILED: CMakeFiles/crossguid.dir/src/guid.cpp.o 
/usr/lib/ccache/bin/c++ -DGUID_LIBUUID -I/home/alex/code/vcpkg/buildtrees/crossguid/src/08ee1b7681-f70a1f9530.clean/include -I/home/alex/code/vcpkg/installed/x64-linux/include -fPIC -g -std=c++17 -fPIC -MD -MT CMakeFiles/crossguid.dir/src/guid.cpp.o -MF CMakeFiles/crossguid.dir/src/guid.cpp.o.d -o CMakeFiles/crossguid.dir/src/guid.cpp.o -c /home/alex/code/vcpkg/buildtrees/crossguid/src/08ee1b7681-f70a1f9530.clean/src/guid.cpp
In file included from /home/alex/code/vcpkg/buildtrees/crossguid/src/08ee1b7681-f70a1f9530.clean/src/guid.cpp:26:
/home/alex/code/vcpkg/buildtrees/crossguid/src/08ee1b7681-f70a1f9530.clean/include/crossguid/guid.hpp: In member function ‘std::size_t std::hash<xg::Guid>::operator()(const xg::Guid&) const’:
/home/alex/code/vcpkg/buildtrees/crossguid/src/08ee1b7681-f70a1f9530.clean/include/crossguid/guid.hpp:145:31: error: ‘uint64_t’ does not name a type
  145 |                         const uint64_t* p = reinterpret_cast<const uint64_t*>(guid.bytes().data());
      |                               ^~~~~~~~
/home/alex/code/vcpkg/buildtrees/crossguid/src/08ee1b7681-f70a1f9530.clean/include/crossguid/guid.hpp:39:1: note: ‘uint64_t’ is defined in header ‘<cstdint>’; did you forget to ‘#include <cstdint>’?
   38 | #include <iomanip>
  +++ |+#include <cstdint>
   39 | 
/home/alex/code/vcpkg/buildtrees/crossguid/src/08ee1b7681-f70a1f9530.clean/include/crossguid/guid.hpp:146:50: error: ‘uint64_t’ was not declared in this scope
  146 |                         return xg::details::hash<uint64_t, uint64_t>{}(p[0], p[1]);
      |                                                  ^~~~~~~~
/home/alex/code/vcpkg/buildtrees/crossguid/src/08ee1b7681-f70a1f9530.clean/include/crossguid/guid.hpp:146:50: note: ‘uint64_t’ is defined in header ‘<cstdint>’; did you forget to ‘#include <cstdint>’?
/home/alex/code/vcpkg/buildtrees/crossguid/src/08ee1b7681-f70a1f9530.clean/include/crossguid/guid.hpp:146:68: error: template argument 1 is invalid
  146 |                         return xg::details::hash<uint64_t, uint64_t>{}(p[0], p[1]);
      |                                                                    ^
/home/alex/code/vcpkg/buildtrees/crossguid/src/08ee1b7681-f70a1f9530.clean/include/crossguid/guid.hpp:146:72: error: ‘p’ was not declared in this scope
  146 |                         return xg::details::hash<uint64_t, uint64_t>{}(p[0], p[1]);
      |                                                                        ^
ninja: build stopped: subcommand failed.
```
